subject: ela
intro: Seventh graders develop and strengthen writing by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, with guidance from peers and adults. Revising improves content and organization (ideas, clarity, structure); editing fixes mechanics (grammar, spelling, punctuation). Both make the final piece stronger.

items.prompt: What is the difference between REVISING and EDITING?

steps: Revising changes content and organization; editing fixes mechanics.
So revising improves ideas and structure; editing corrects grammar, spelling, and punctuation.
solution.answer: Revising improves ideas/structure; editing fixes grammar, spelling, punctuation.
